jamal: Scheduling a staging pen-test dry run Tues 09:00 PT. Need ops lead, uploader, and a clear evidence manifest (no DB exports).
emily: Agree. Manifest should include object, sha256, kms_key_arn, presign_ttl, uploader, grant_arn, and signature.
jamal: Good. KMS grants should be time-bound and constrained to an encryption-context (purpose=pt-evidence). Avoid broad kms:Decrypt on the key.
tanya: I can ops lead. Ops will provide a 1h rolling log slice and targeted 24h for any flagged endpoints. I'll run sanitization (remove PII, obfuscate IPs, strip secrets) at 08:30 PT.
mike: I'll script upload + grant creation. Plan: create grant with EncryptionContextSubset and return grant ARN + presign URL.
kms-bot: Grant example:
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/staging-logs --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-auditor --operations Decrypt --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"purpose":"pt-evidence"}
```
mike: Uploaded to staging. Manifest presign: https://staging.s3/.../svc-logs-manifest.json, grant arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:grant/9f8e7d6c (TTL 3600s). I'll monitor access logs.
jamal: Retest plan: 2-week window after fixes. If a fix expands privileges, freeze deploys for the service and escalate in #incidents. Action items: tanya ops + sanitization, mike upload (done), emily verify manifest signing, jamal coordinate assessor. React with :thumbsup: to ack.
